name: Long-context downshift
optimizes: Huge-context requests go to a cheaper long-context model instead of an expensive flagship.
description: Large prompts (long documents, big RAG payloads, full chat histories) dominate token spend. This recipe sends any request over ~32k input tokens to gemini-3.1-flash-lite — a 1M-token-window model priced far below the flagships — so your biggest prompts cost the least per token.
